_doc: TEMPLATE STORY SCENES. A scene binds a background image, a music track, and an entry dialogue node. Chapter/act/milestone fields feed the spoken Quest Recap and the debug chapter-warp menu — no story metadata is hardcoded in engine classes.

scenes.name: The Proving Grounds
scenes.ambientDescription: An ancient vaulted chamber where stone glyphs hum in resonance with spoken incantations.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You entered the proving grounds, explored the sanctuary corridors, and listened to the opening chronicle.
scenes.defaultObjective: Explore the sanctuary corridors and advance through the story.

scenes.name: The Echo Hall
scenes.ambientDescription: A vast hall of polished stone where every spoken word returns twice, welcoming the traveler into the grand archive.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You explored the Echo Hall and arrived at the sanctuary archive.
scenes.defaultObjective: Walk the Echo Hall to conclude the starter chronicle.
